api: POST https://api.mobbin.com/v1/screens/search — Bearer Team/Enterprise, body {query, platform: ios|web, mode: deep|standard, limit}
query_rules: Describe one screen plain language — UI elements + relation. Good: 'login screen with biometric authentication', 'checkout page with promo code field and Apple Pay button'. Avoid: multiple screens/intents, negations, vague style words, keyword lists.

for_factory.ux_research: Search before DS-001 — provide 3-5 screens as reference to UX_UI + FRONTEND
for_factory.prompt_injection: Add to TASK: 'Reference Mobbin: {mobbin_url} — reproduce structure/spacing, not copy pixels'
for_factory.without_key: Use manual search https://mobbin.com/search + Figma plugin + mock mode tools/mobbin.py
